description: This file defines the class ProjectActivityDetailedReportSearchFilterParams, which extends another class to specify filter parameters for a detailed project activity report within the OrangeHRM Time module. It includes a property for project activity ID and methods to get and set this property.

classes.name: ProjectActivityDetailedReportSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object class encapsulating filter parameters for detailed project activity reports, including a project activity ID and sorting options.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameter object and sets the default sort field to 'employee.lastName'.

methods.name: getProjectActivityId
methods.description: Returns the project activity ID filter, which can be null or an integer.

methods.name: setProjectActivityId
methods.description: Sets the project activity ID filter to the provided value, which can be null or an integer.
